assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==MANIFEST_SHA
manifest=json.loads(raw)
runs=[("stt",61653,72847),("dt",61654,72848),("at",61655,72849)]
contract=dict(checkpoint_sha="c510c04d987d141423401a25323ea353314107a16f4dac5d2901370ab199fa52",step=59716)
fatal_patterns=("Traceback (most recent call last)","CUDA out of memory","Fatal Python error","AssertionError")
offsets={}; previous_counts={}; previous_log_sizes={}
for snapshot in range(25):

    if snapshot in (0,12,24):
        states={}
        for task,jid,tid in runs:
            p=subprocess.run(["/data/nas_ray/home/zeying.gong/algorithm/envs/md_ai_kit_submit/bin/md_ai_kit","detail","--job",str(jid)],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True,timeout=30)
            lines=[s.strip() for s in p.stdout.splitlines() if s.strip().startswith("Status") or s.strip().startswith("Created")]
            assert lines,("missing scheduler state",jid,p.stdout)
            states[task]=lines
        result["scheduler"]=states
    allkeys=set()
    for task,jid,tid in runs:
        taskroot=Path(f"/data/nas_ray/project/md-ak/users/zeying.gong/job_{jid}/task_{tid}")
        root=taskroot/f"wa_student61609_{task}_a800_v1"
        lanes=[]; seen=set(); invalid=0; partial=0; completions=0; ready_count=0
        logs=[taskroot/"console.log",taskroot/".md-ak/workload.log"]
        worker_ages=[]; rows_ages=[]; row_bytes=0
        for lane in range(8):
            dest=root/f"shard_{lane:02d}"
            ready=json.loads((dest/"server_ready.json").read_text())
            validate_ready(ready,mode="mixed",**contract)
            assert "A800" in ready["gpu"]
            ready_count+=1
            f=dest/"episodes.jsonl"; data=f.read_bytes(); row_bytes+=len(data)
            lines=data.splitlines(keepends=True)
            if lines and not lines[-1].endswith(b"\n"):
                partial+=1; lines=lines[:-1]
            local=[json.loads(s) for s in lines if s.strip()]
            expected={e["key"] for e in manifest["tasks"][task]["episodes"] if e["shard"]==lane}
            for row in local:
                key=(row["task"],row["key"])
                assert row["task"]==task and row["key"] in expected,("foreign row",key,lane)
                assert key not in seen and key not in allkeys,("duplicate",key)
                seen.add(key);allkeys.add(key)
                assert row["checkpoint_sha256"]==contract["checkpoint_sha"] and row["checkpoint_step"]==contract["step"]
                assert row["mode"]=="mixed" and row["noise_mode"]=="zero"
                assert row["controller"]=="learned_yaw_guard_v1" and row["semantic_protocol"]=="mp3d_semantic_ply_v1"
                if key in KEYS:
                    assert row["initialization_repair"]==VERSION and row["initialization_repair_plan_sha256"]==REPAIR_SHA
                else: assert not row.get("initialization_repair")
                assert type(row["policy_init_valid"]) is bool
                invalid+=int(not row["policy_init_valid"])
                assert row["success"] in (False,True,0,1) and row["collision"] in (False,True,0,1)
            lanes.append(len(local));completions+=int((dest/"COMPLETE.json").exists())
            logs.extend([dest/"worker.log",dest/"server.log"])
            worker_ages.append(round(now-(dest/"worker.log").stat().st_mtime,2))
            rows_ages.append(round(now-f.stat().st_mtime,2))
        hits=[]; logbytes=0
        for path in logs:
            assert path.is_file(),("required_log_missing",str(path))
            size=path.stat().st_size;start=offsets.get(str(path),0)
            assert size>=start,("log_truncated",str(path))
            with path.open("rb") as stream:
                stream.seek(max(0,start-512)); data=stream.read()
            for marker in fatal_patterns:
                count=data.count(marker.encode())
                if count: hits.append(dict(path=str(path),pattern=marker,count=count))
            offsets[str(path)]=size;logbytes+=size
        count=len(seen);before=previous_counts.get(task)
        result["tasks"][task]=dict(job=jid,task_id=tid,completed=count,lanes=lanes,delta=None if before is None else count-before,
            invalid_init=invalid,ready=ready_count,complete_shards=completions,partial_tails=partial,row_bytes=row_bytes,
            log_bytes=logbytes,log_growth=None if task not in previous_log_sizes else logbytes-previous_log_sizes[task],
            worker_log_age_s=worker_ages,episode_file_age_s=rows_ages,fatal_hits=hits,
            partition_complete=(root/"PARTITION_COMPLETE.json").exists())
        if before is not None: assert count>=before
        previous_counts[task]=count;previous_log_sizes[task]=logbytes
    result["unique_completed"]=len(allkeys)
    print(json.dumps(result,allow_nan=False),flush=True)
    if any(r["fatal_hits"] for r in result["tasks"].values()): raise RuntimeError("specified fatal signature found; inspect original task, do not restart automatically")
    if all(r["partition_complete"] for r in result["tasks"].values()): break
    if snapshot<24:time.sleep(50)
print("BOUNDED_READONLY_WATCH_FINISHED_NOT_JOB_COMPLETION",flush=True)
